basis.guide_semantics: Position size denomination is underlying currency; average price is USDT contract value divided by position quantity.

inference: The depth descriptor establishes coin quantity. The generic perpetual guide identifies the same venue underlying-currency quantity denomination. For each explicit ordinary native asset tuple the combination supports price USDT per exact native asset and Coin quantity in that asset, without a separate product page for every ordinary asset. This is a documented scoped inference, not a new universal field guarantee.
limits: Exact reviewed tuples only; future/new/changed tuple needs review
Nine explicit denomination ambiguities remain UNKNOWN, not UNSUPPORTED or removed from universe
No language, display-name or generic numeric prefix filtering
Current catalog + actual Coin arrays + original T + fresh two-sided shape still required by existing runtime
No cross-venue canonical binding, multiplier, quantity step or execution guarantee
Old13 and APT qualification remain untouched; ROOT owns adoption
